loved.heading: Nothing loved yet

playlists.heading: Make your first playlist

downloads.heading: Listen without a connection

bookmarks.heading: Mark verses to come back to

notes.heading: Keep your thoughts on a verse

reciters.heading: Keep your reciters close
reciters.message: Tap Favorite on a reciter’s page, or add a few now.

uploads.heading: Bring your own recordings
uploads.message: Add audio from Files, then tag the surah and reciter.
